007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Profile;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import org.slf4j.Logger;
014import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
015
016import java.util.List;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for listing Select AI profiles by database regular-expression pattern.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, call
022 * {@link SelectAI#listProfiles(String)}, and print profile metadata returned by
023 * the SDK.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
026 * <ul>
027 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
028 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
029 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
030 * </ul>
031 *
032 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
033 * <ul>
034 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME_PATTERN, default {@code .*}</li>
035 * </ul>
036 *
037 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
038 * <pre>{@code
039 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
040 * }</pre>
041 *
042 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
043 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
044 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
045 * <pre>{@code
046 * mvn clean install
047 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
048 * }</pre>
049 *
050 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
051 * <pre>{@code
052 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
053 *   -d samples/out \
054 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/profile/ListProfilesByPatternSample.java
055 * }</pre>
056 *
057 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
058 * <pre>{@code
059 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
060 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.profile.ListProfilesByPatternSample
061 * }</pre>
062 *
063 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
064 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
065 * and diagnostics.</p>
066 */
067public final class ListProfilesByPatternSample {
068    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ListProfilesByPatternSample.class);
069
070    private ListProfilesByPatternSample() {
071    }
072
073    public static void main(String[] args) {
074        String profileNamePattern = envOrDefault("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME_PATTERN", ".*");
075        try {
076            DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
077                    .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
078                    .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
079                    .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
080                    .build();
081
082            SelectAI selectAI = SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
083            List<Profile> profiles = selectAI.listProfiles(profileNamePattern);
084
085            if (profiles.isEmpty()) {
086                System.out.printf("No Select AI profiles found for pattern: %s%n", profileNamePattern);
087                return;
088            }
089
090            System.out.printf("Found %d Select AI profile(s) for pattern %s:%n",
091                    profiles.size(), profileNamePattern);
092            for (Profile profile : profiles) {
093                System.out.println("----------------------------------------");
094                System.out.printf("Profile name : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getProfileName()));
095                System.out.printf("Status       : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getStatus()));
096                System.out.printf("Description  : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(profile.getDescription()));
097            }
098        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
099            LOGGER.error("Failed to list Select AI profiles for pattern '{}'.", profileNamePattern, e);
100        }
101    }
102
103    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
104        String value = System.getenv(name);
105        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
106            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
107        }
108        return value;
109    }
110
111    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
112        String value = System.getenv(name);
113        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
114    }
115
116    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
117        return value == null ? "" : value;
118    }
119}
